questions.question_text:
Seven people A-G; years 1985, 1988, 1990, 1991, 1994, 1997, 2001. A has an odd birth year; D is two positions after A; exactly three years separate C and E, with C older and E in an even year; number between D/E equals number between B/F; G is younger than F.

Question: C was born in which year?
questions.explanation: The unique ordering assigns C to 1985. The other clues place A=1991, D=1997, E=1988, F=1990, G=1994, B=2001.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 01 Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 4-6

questions.question_text:
Eight people L-S; years 1987, 1989, 1990, 1992, 1995, 1997, 1999, 2004. R is five years older than M; at least two are older than R; count older than R equals count younger than S; three people between S and P; two between S and L, with L younger than S; N is two years older than O.

Question: Who was born in 1995?

options.A: The person born immediately before P
options.B: The person born two persons after Q

questions.explanation: The unique arrangement puts L in 1995 and P in 1997, so L is immediately before P.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 01 Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 7-9

questions.question_text:
Seven people D,E,F,G,H,I,J; years 1980, 1984, 1990, 1994, 1999, 2003, 2007. E is a leap year; three people between E and D; one between D and H; H and G differ by four years; G is older than D; positional gap E/G equals D/J; I is older than F but not eldest.

Question: H was born in which year?
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 01 Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 10-12

questions.question_text:
Eight people C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J born on 28 August in years 1972, 1975, 1978, 1982, 1987, 1989, 1996, 1997. Ages at 28 Aug 2020. More than two people between H/J; J age multiple of 11; J/G age difference 9; I immediately after F, whose year is odd; people before C are one fewer than people after C; at most three people between D/E, with E after D.

Question: Who was born in 1978?
questions.explanation: The unique assignment places I in 1978.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 02 Class Notes-.pdf; physical page(s) 5-7

questions.question_text:
Seven people A-G have distinct birth years 1950-2000; ages as of 2020. D is fourth oldest and born 1989 (age31). The person adjacent to D and second younger than A differs in age by 5. Number older than A equals number younger than E. Person adjacent to E is age25, which is 20 less than A. F has square age and was born immediately after C in consecutive leap years. G age is average of D/B; B is two years older than youngest.

Question: What is the age of G?
questions.explanation: The constraints force A=45, C=40, F=36, D=31, B=25, G=28, E=23. Thus G is eight years younger than F. Constrained enumeration over integer ages 20-70 yields one assignment.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 02 Class Notes-.pdf; physical page(s) 8-10

questions.question_text:
Eight people A-H have distinct ages from 10 to 41 (reference year 2021). G is a square age; F=G+1; H=F-10; A=2H; G+H=C+1; E=H+2; D=E+1; |B-H|=|H-D|.

Question: Who is the youngest person?
questions.explanation: Algebra plus the age bounds yields one valid assignment: A32, B13, C40, D19, E18, F26, G25, H16. B is the youngest at 13.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 03 _ Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 4-6

questions.question_text:
Eight friends P-W born in 1975,1979,1981,1985,1987,1991,1997,2000 (age reference 1 Jan 2019). R/S age difference 10, R older; three between R/Q with Q after R; two between U/V; W immediately after V; age(W)+age(T)=age(P)+1.

Question: What is the age difference between R and Q?
questions.explanation: Unique arrangement: R=1975 (age44), Q=1987 (age32), so the difference is 12.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 03 _ Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 7-9

questions.question_text:
Ten people P-Y born in 1960,1964,1971,1975,1979,1983,1988,1990,1995,2000 (ages as of 2020). Before P count is one more than after P; three between P/W; Q age prime; R immediately before Q; |S-R| is two less than |R-U|; two between Q/S; V and X have square ages; one between X/Y and Y is eldest.

Question: How many people were born between P and the person born in 1971?

options.A: As many as between Y and X
options.B: As many as between U and the person born in 1995
options.C: As many as between P and the person born in 1995
options.D: As many as between R and U

questions.explanation: Unique order is Y,S,X,R,Q,P,U,T,V,W from earliest to latest year. The requested count is two. Option C also describes two (P/V have two between); option D also describes two (R/U have Q and P between), so E “Both C & D” is the sole correct option.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 03 _ Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 10-13

questions.question_text:
Eight workers P-W have ages 13,15,16,19,22,26,31,37 and distinct companies Facebook, Google, Snapdeal, HCL, IBM, Infosys, Flipkart, Wipro. S is 6 older than Infosys worker and S even; R=Snapdeal and not younger than S; 2 people between R/Facebook; U= W+7 and W not Wipro; Wipro worker and V have the minimum age gap; T younger than V and not IBM; eldest HCL; P not HCL; Google worker is 4 younger than Flipkart worker.

Question: Which person is working in IBM?

options.A: The one who is two years elder than T
options.B: The one who is three years younger than V
options.C: The one who is five years elder than U
options.D: The one who is one year elder than P

questions.explanation: Unique arrangement assigns V age16 and P age13 at IBM; P is three years younger than V. A is false because no listed person is 2 years older than T (15); C names R (31), and D would require age14.
questions.source: PDF: Scheduling Puzzles Year Based Puzzles 04 _ Class Notes.pdf; physical page(s) 8-11
